title: S4-LEARN-06 — Pocket has a desk of its own.
goal: The Playground fits the window it is given: below 1024 px it is the Pocket Doodle Pad, at desktop width the full practice workspace. Either way it opens on the Bouncy Mochi lesson with Pen, Fill and Eraser tools, colour swatches and the lesson's frames.

steps.say: The page shows either the Pocket Doodle Pad (heading 'Pocket Doodle Pad', for narrow windows) or the desktop practice workspace (heading ending 'make Bouncy Mochi'), whichever suits this window's width.

steps.why: The lesson's frames start at frame 1.
